description: The register of publisher prefixes under https://w3id.org/battinfo/ (IDENTIFIER_POLICY.md 6.4). A publisher mints records under id/{prefix}/ when records is true, and defines its own terms under def/{prefix}/. records_rdf and records_page say where the records minted under a prefix live: each is an https URL template, for a record's RDF and for its human page, in which {uid} stands for the record's uid and {segment}, which is optional, for its segment, such as cell. Both are null for a prefix that holds definitions only, for 1001, whose records the Battery Genome registry serves itself, and for a holder that serves no records by uid. Validated by prefixes.schema.json.
